tools.purpose: Generate the three stages of an injection chain (blob, loader, injector) with every target-specific number left as a named placeholder, so offsets come from the sample instead of from memory.
tools.expect: four files under --out: payload.bin with a self-checking header, loader.py, injector.py and chain.md listing the placeholders still to fill

notes: Generated, not executed: the blob body is inert (win: zeros, linux: a nop sled plus ret) and both scripts only print their plan. Four of the five placeholders can only be filled after triage_binary and disasm, which is the point — a chain whose holes are unnamed is a chain somebody fills with a guess.
